projects.title: Rawdati — Educational Platform & Kindergarten Portal
projects.subtitle: Interactive Early Childhood Learning Portal, Online Admission System & Parent Dashboard
projects.summary: A modern, highly responsive educational web platform engineered for kindergarten and early childhood centers. Features interactive learning activity showcases, digital student admission and enrollment workflows, parent-teacher communication portal, and a playful, touch-friendly UI optimized for families across all devices.
projects.description:
### Project Overview
**Rawdati (روضتي)** is an educational web platform and digital portal designed to connect kindergartens, nurseries, and early learning academies with parents and families. Deployed live on Vercel at [rawdati-website.vercel.app](https://rawdati-website.vercel.app/), the platform delivers an engaging visual presentation of educational programs alongside seamless digital admission workflows.

### Key Full-Stack Features
- **Responsive Visual Storytelling**: Bright, joyful, and touch-optimized interface presenting early childhood curriculums, creative arts, physical activities, and language phonics.
- **Digital Admission & Enrollment Engine**: Step-by-step online registration form allowing parents to enroll their children, select age cohorts, upload required health certificates, and schedule campus orientation tours.
- **Parent & Faculty Communication Portal**: Centralized hub for daily learning schedules, photo activity diaries, lunch menus, and instant announcements.
- **100% Responsive Architecture**: Built with modern web standards to ensure instant rendering and frictionless navigation across mobile smartphones, iPads, tablets, and large displays.
projects.architectureNotes: React.js & Next.js -> Tailwind CSS Responsive Layouts -> Serverless API Routes -> Cloud Storage CDN -> Deployed Live on Vercel Edge

projects.title: NovaMart — Full-Stack E-Commerce & Online Shopping Store
projects.subtitle: Complete Online Shopping Storefront, Smart Cart, Stripe Checkout & Inventory Admin CMS
projects.summary: A complete full-stack e-commerce and online shopping platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. Features high-speed product discovery, instant category filtering, interactive shopping cart, secure Stripe payment gateway, and a comprehensive merchant dashboard for inventory and order management.
projects.description:
### Project Overview
**NovaMart E-Commerce** is a modern full-stack online shopping platform engineered to deliver a fast, frictionless buying experience across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices while giving store owners complete control over products, inventory, and orders.

### Key Full-Stack Features
- **Responsive Storefront & Smart Filtering**: Dynamic product catalog with instant search, category segmentation, product ratings, and a live slide-over shopping bag.
- **Multi-Gateway Checkout**: Integrated with **Stripe API**, **Apple Pay**, and Cash on Delivery with automated order confirmation and shipment status tracking.
- **Merchant Admin & Inventory Dashboard**: Real-time sales analytics, low-stock alerts, coupon management, and one-click order fulfillment workflows.
projects.architectureNotes: Next.js & React Frontend -> Node.js & Express REST API -> PostgreSQL Database + Redis Cache -> Stripe Payment Webhook Engine

projects.title: GustoQR — Restaurant Digital Menu & Order Management System
projects.subtitle: Interactive QR Table Menu, Online Food Ordering, Kitchen Display (KDS) & Menu Admin Dashboard
projects.summary: An end-to-end digital restaurant menu and order management platform allowing dine-in and delivery customers to scan a table QR code, browse photo-rich dishes, customize items, and send orders directly to the live Kitchen Display System (KDS), paired with an intuitive Admin CMS for managing categories, dishes, and prices in real time.
projects.description:
### Project Overview
**GustoQR Restaurant Menu System** modernizes restaurant and cafe operations by connecting QR table ordering, delivery menus, kitchen preparation screens, and menu administration into one seamless web platform.

### Key Full-Stack Features
- **Interactive Mobile QR Menu**: Customers scan the table QR code to browse appetizing dishes with photos, calories, and preparation times, customize add-ons, and submit orders without waiting.
- **Real-Time Restaurant Menu Manager (Admin CMS)**: Restaurant managers can add new dishes, update prices, launch daily specials, or mark items as sold-out with instant synchronization.
- **Live Kitchen Display System (KDS)**: Orders appear immediately on the kitchen screen via **WebSockets** with preparation timers and table status tracking.
projects.architectureNotes: React & TypeScript Mobile-First Menu -> Node.js & Express API -> MongoDB Atlas -> WebSocket Real-Time Kitchen Display (KDS)
